candidate.content: When searching for lettuce in a kitchen environment, inspecting open surfaces (countertops) before closed storage units (fridge, cabinets) can locate the target without requiring any 'open' actions. In this instance, navigating sequentially to countertop_1 then countertop_2 found lettuce_1 on the second open surface inspected, achieving acquisition in 3 total actions and 2 receptacle inspections.
candidate.scope: Kitchen environments where lettuce may be placed on open countertops rather than inside refrigerators or cabinets; applicable to the search-and-acquisition phase only, not downstream cooling or placement steps.

Navigating to countertop_2 revealed lettuce_1 and lettuce_2 among the visible objects.
Lettuce_1 was successfully taken from countertop_2 into inventory.

minimal_global_context: The initial observation listed multiple receptacle types including fridge_1, cabinets, drawers, shelves, and countertops as available navigation targets.
